title: 盈利增28%：台积电却不动，2028后靠什么撑？
speaker: Adrian Zuercher

segments.en: Given how reliable and anthropic is on companies like TSMC, just tell us what's going on in Taiwan today.
segments.zh: 鉴于台积电等公司的可靠性和吸引力，请告诉我们今天台湾的情况。

segments.en: Why is it not really moving that much? Well, I think we should, I mean, it was closed as well.
segments.zh: 为什么它没有太大变动？嗯，我认为我们应该，我的意思是，它也已经关闭了。

segments.en: We have seen, there was a correction on tech and semiconductors name, particularly over the last couple of weeks as well.
segments.zh: 我们已经看到，科技和半导体板块出现了调整，尤其是在过去几周。

segments.en: The earnings season is very positive. We have 28% earnings growth, particularly from the AI part.
segments.zh: 财报季非常积极。我们看到了28%的盈利增长，尤其是来自人工智能部分。

segments.en: And half of the AI earnings are actually coming from semiconductors.
segments.zh: 而人工智能盈利的一半实际上来自半导体。

segments.en: So, it's a very good momentum. But I think investors also want to really have the numbers concretely and there's still a question mark beyond 2028, what will happen.
segments.zh: 所以，势头非常好。但我认为市场参与者也希望具体看到数字，而且2028年之后仍有一个问号，会发生什么。

segments.en: And I think that's sort of the part where some investors may reposition themselves.
segments.zh: 我认为，这可能是部分市场参与者重新配置的环节。

segments.en: As we also did, particularly in Taiwan. The cost of capital, that was always the big thing that was worrying the market on whether it would derail this AI boom in any way.
segments.zh: 正如我们也在台湾所做的那样。资本成本一直是市场担忧的大事，担心它是否会以任何方式破坏这轮人工智能热潮。
